headline: Housing slump squeezes margins as outlook is trimmed
summary_short: Builders FirstSource reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $3.86 billion, down 8.8% y/y, as gross margin contracted 260bp to 28.1% and diluted EPS swung to a $(0.04) loss from $1.66 a year ago amid a weaker housing-starts environment.
summary_long: Revenue fell 8.8% y/y to $3.86 billion on a 7.0% core organic sales decline (Single Family -8.1%, Multi-Family -9.7%, R&R -1.8%) and 2.7% commodity deflation, partly offset by 0.9% acquisition growth. Gross margin contracted 260bp to 28.1% on the weaker housing-starts environment, driving income from operations down 58.7% to $128.5 million. Net income swung to a $3.9 million loss ($(0.04) diluted EPS) from $185.0 million ($1.66) a year ago, hurt by lower gross profit, higher net interest expense, and an IRS R&D settlement that lifted tax expense, partly offset by lower SG&A. Free cash flow fell to $32.2 million from $255.0 million. Builders FirstSource guided 2026 net sales to $14.0-$14.8 billion and Adjusted EBITDA to $1.0-$1.2 billion.
